text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The main event is finally here.
Are you mentally prepared?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That is truly worthy of my Trainer...
a Trainer for a Mejiro Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Just the right amount of tension.
My body is starting to heat up...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer.
For the sake of the dream I must fulfill... I'm off!
